login_identity_admin_link.name: login_identity_admin_link
login_identity_admin_link.value:
("login_identity"."portal" = 'admin') = ("login_identity"."admin_staff_id" is not null)
    and ("login_identity"."portal" = 'teacher') = ("login_identity"."teacher_id" is not null)
    and ("login_identity"."portal" = 'parent') = ("login_identity"."contact_id" is not null)
    and ("login_identity"."portal" = 'student') = ("login_identity"."student_id" is not null)

teacher_log_times.name: teacher_log_times
teacher_log_times.value: "teacher_log"."time_out" is null or "teacher_log"."time_in" is null or "teacher_log"."time_out" >= "teacher_log"."time_in"
